last.verdict: CoreWeave beat on sales and lifted its 2026 outlook as its order backlog hit $132.5B, but a $709M quarterly loss and heavy debt remain the concern.

takeaways.label: Beat and raise
takeaways.text: Revenue was $3.66B, up about 168% from a year ago, versus roughly $3.55B expected. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13.0–13.3B.

takeaways.label: Backlog keeps growing
takeaways.text: Contracted backlog reached $132.5B, up from about $104B last quarter, reinforcing demand for AI computing capacity.

takeaways.label: Losses and debt
takeaways.text: Net loss was $709M, with interest costs of $846M in the quarter and about $47B of debt. Analysts flagged financing as the main risk.

history.verdict: Profit beat and a higher revenue outlook outweighed bigger spending plans and widening losses.

reasons.label: Profit far above plan
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income hit $128M, more than double the company's own ~$60M target.

reasons.label: Higher revenue outlook
reasons.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $12.4–13.2B; Q3 guide of $3.45–3.6B beat $3.43B consensus.

reasons.label: Backlog keeps ballooning
reasons.text: Contracted backlog reached about $104B, up 246% from a year earlier.
